props.name: children

props.name: fillStyle
props.description: The background style of the LinkButton.

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the LinkButton.

props.description: The static color style to apply. Useful when the LinkButton appears over a color background.

props.name: styles
props.description: Spectrum-defined generated classes.

props.description: Additional CSS class name. Use only as a last resort.

props.description: A slot name for the component.

props.description: Ref for the underlying link element.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Handler that is called when the element loses focus.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Handler that is called when the element receives focus.

props.name: onKeyDown
props.description: Handler that is called when a key is pressed.

props.name: onKeyUp
props.description: Handler that is called when a key is released.

props.name: aria-current
props.description: Indicates the current "page" or state within a set of related elements.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.

props.name: aria-details
props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that provide a detailed description.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.

props.description: The URL to link to.

props.description: The target window for the link.

props.description: The relationship between the linked resource and the current page.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Handler that is called when the press is released over the target.

props.name: onPressStart
props.description: Handler that is called when a press interaction starts.

props.name: onPressEnd
props.description: Handler that is called when a press interaction ends.

props.name: onPressUp

props.name: onPressChange

props.name: routerOptions
props.description: Additional options forwarded to client-side router navigation handlers.

props.name: hrefLang
props.description: Hints the language of the linked resource.

props.name: download
props.description: Instructs the browser to download the URL instead of navigating to it.

props.name: ping
props.description: Space-separated list of URLs to ping when following the link.

props.name: referrerPolicy
props.description: Referrer policy for fetches initiated by this link.

props.name: onFocusChange
props.description: Handler that is called when the element's focus status changes.
